answer: Anchor each agent to one verified bank account via micro-deposits: the network sends two random cent amounts, the agent reports both within 48 hours, a $100 bond locks 90 days, and peers re-check yearly. A duplicate account voids both identities and burns both bonds, so each identity sits on its own island of banking history. The amounts echo back as proof no bot farm can fake: forging 10,000 identities needs 10,000 real bank accounts, $1,000,000 in bonds, $250,000 in deposits and 60 days of in-person KYC. That is the nadir of cheap sybil attacks, like photocopying passports.
